what: While a horizontally overflowing strip (timeline, card row) is visible on screen, it drifts left by itself at 22px per second, and at the end it loops seamlessly into a second copy joined on. Hover pauses it, dragging pushes it along with your hand, and the left and right keys move it 280px at a time — it rests 4 seconds after any touch, then flows again. On phone it simply scrolls with the finger (not blocked)

options.step: Pixels moved per left/right key press, default 280
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Cells to append (children) — if none, all children of the strip

note: The band must be a horizontal panel with overflow-x: auto (the scrollbar is hidden by the user). The second set is attached with aria-hidden and tabindex -1

from.where: index.js .hi__track (blue band timeline) — original initHistory: one duplicate set, moves at dt × .022px/ms while visible, stops during mouse hover·press·drag·touch, rests 4000ms after release, left/right keys ±280, one loop is the second set’s first slot position − the first set’s first slot position
